purpose: test whether the selected data transfers across dense and hybrid architectures and whether individually selected architecture settings compose into one launchable flagship recipe

experiments.name: crossed data-mixture by architecture transfer
experiments.primary_analysis: paired two-factor data and architecture main effects plus their interaction on parser-independent equal-category BPB

estimands.data_main_effect: one half times ((selected minus prior within dense) plus (selected minus prior within hybrid))
estimands.architecture_main_effect: one half times ((hybrid minus dense on prior) plus (hybrid minus dense on selected))
estimands.interaction: (selected minus prior within hybrid) minus (selected minus prior within dense)
estimands.seed_unit: compute each estimand within seed before aggregation
estimands.uncertainty: two-sided 95 percent Student-t interval over the five paired seed estimands
estimands.null_interpretation: an interval spanning zero is unresolved and must not be described as proof of no interaction

experiments.decision_authority: none; E2c remains the data-selection authority and any interaction narrows the transfer claim rather than reopening mixture search

experiments.name: assembled flagship recipe confirmation
experiments.treatment: one configuration applying every individually promoted compatible D2 D3 D7 D8 setting
experiments.assembly_rule: D2 and D3 apply when promoted; D7 selects the recurrent operator; D8 applies only if KDA remains selected; no untested setting or subset may enter
experiments.control_reuse: C0 only under exact tokenizer data order optimizer schedule precision horizon evaluation and analysis identity

analysis.primary_operational_view: paired treatment-minus-C0 loss at matched wall-clock
analysis.aggregate_bound: upper one-sided 95 percent paired Student-t bound at or below 0.01 nats
analysis.source_bound: every upper one-sided 95 percent paired Student-t bound at or below 0.02 nats

experiments.pass_rule: the assembled treatment must pass the architecture aggregate and source non-inferiority bounds, 32K and 128K capability gates, original-4K retention, and each promoted component's declared promotion benefit
experiments.failure_rule: launch the complete C0 default; do not search post-hoc subsets or spend reserve on rescue combinations
experiments.no_new_run_rule: if no compatible alternative promotes, C0 is already the assembled recipe and the unused envelope is not spent

experiments.name: integrated capability and systems analysis
required_outputs: I1 factorial effect and interaction plot with seed uncertainty
I2 assembled-versus-C0 forest plot with every source and seed
measured training time memory and energy
mechanism report linking intervention effects to language loss retrieval composition and state cost

paper_outputs: an explicit statement of whether data and architecture gains transfer independently
an explicit statement of whether individually selected architecture settings compose
binding: no new data source or mixture search
five paired I1 seeds and three paired I2 seeds
I2 completes before the scale ladder
the scale ladder and flagship use only I2-confirmed assembly or complete C0 fallback

supersedes.reason: increase the central data-by-architecture interaction to five paired seeds and add no-training mechanism interventions without reopening E2 or component search
